name: codeapi-adapter
description: Minimal JS bootstrap that launches and supervises the Python CODEAPI runtime and bridges irreducible vscode.* operations. DESIGN SKELETON — not the active extension until the Phase-14 cutover.
//: This is the adapter's OWN manifest. The root package.json main still points at ./dist/extension.js; pointing it here is a Phase-14 item (see docs/PYTHON_RUNTIME_BOOTSTRAP.md).

codeapi.pythonServicePortBase.description: Base port for the Python runtime service (must be OUTSIDE the VS Code window band 3637-3646 until the Phase-14 cutover).

codeapi.pythonPath.description: Explicit python.exe path for dev mode (avoid .bat shims). Empty = use bundled runtime if present, else python.exe on PATH.

dependencies.//: node-pty 1.1.0 (N-API, ABI-stable) — matches the repo root node_modules/node-pty. Required by the /vscode/term/* bridge and the /exec `nodePty`/`codeApiTerm` globals. Pinned exact to the proven-loadable prebuild (Phase 14 prerequisite; dev-load validation is a separate operator step).
